Package com.squad93.pos.db

Class OrderRepository

java.lang.Object
com.squad93.pos.db.OrderRepository
public final class OrderRepository extends Object
Persists checkout and inventory consumption together. Call off the JavaFX thread.

  • Method Details

    • submit

      public OrderRepository.OrderReceipt submit(OrderRepository.OrderRequest request) throws IOException, SQLException
      Saves an order and deducts stock atomically using current database prices. Runs blocking work and must be called off the JavaFX thread. A return value confirms commit; if the connection fails during commit, reconcile the outcome before retrying.
      Parameters:
      request - validated order details; must not be null
      Returns:
      the committed order receipt
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if employee, menu, toppings, or stock checks fail, or a transaction operation fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the request is null or calculated amounts exceed database limits

    • submit

      public OrderRepository.OrderReceipt submit(OrderRepository.OrderRequest request, Map<Integer,BigDecimal> quotedPrices) throws IOException, SQLException
      Saves checkout and stock deductions in one transaction, rejecting stale quoted prices. When a quote is supplied, it must contain every ordered drink at its current base price. Topping prices and availability are always checked. A lost connection during commit can leave an uncertain outcome that must be reconciled before another submission.
      Parameters:
      request - validated order details; must not be null
      quotedPrices - displayed base prices keyed by menu item identifier, or null to skip base-price comparison
      Returns:
      the receipt after commit completes
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if checkout validation fails, stock is insufficient, a conflict occurs, or persistence fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the request is null or calculated amounts exceed database limits
      NullPointerException - if a supplied quote contains null keys or values

    • validateToppingsAndLockInventory

      private static void validateToppingsAndLockInventory(Connection connection, List<OrderRepository.OrderLine> lines, Set<Integer> inventoryIds) throws SQLException
      Locks consumed inventory in the supplied iteration order and checks all topping quotes. The checkout caller supplies sorted identifiers so competing orders lock rows consistently.
      Parameters:
      connection - active checkout transaction
      lines - order lines containing quoted toppings
      inventoryIds - all recipe and topping inventory identifiers in ascending order
      Throws:
      SQLException - if inventory is missing, topping settings or prices changed, or locking fails

    • loadMenu

      private static Map<Integer,OrderRepository.MenuItem> loadMenu(Connection connection, List<OrderRepository.OrderLine> lines) throws SQLException
      Loads and locks each ordered drink and recipe in identifier order. Rechecks availability and seasonal dates against the database's current date.
      Parameters:
      connection - active checkout transaction
      lines - requested drink lines
      Returns:
      current prices and nonempty recipes keyed by menu item identifier
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a drink is missing, unavailable, out of season, lacks a recipe, or a query fails

    • deductStock

      private static void deductStock(Connection connection, Map<Integer,BigDecimal> consumption) throws SQLException
      Deducts every consumed quantity only when sufficient stock remains. Any failure is propagated to the caller so the entire checkout can be rolled back.
      Parameters:
      connection - active checkout transaction
      consumption - required stock keyed in ascending inventory identifier order
      Throws:
      SQLException - if an inventory item is missing, has insufficient stock, or cannot be updated
